part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Future
questions: What job would you like to have ten years from now? [Why?]
How useful will English be for your future? [Why/Why not?]
How much travelling do you hope to do in the future? [Why/Why not?]
How do you think your life will change in the future? [Why/Why not?]

part2.topic: Describe a book that you enjoyed reading because you had to think a lot.
points: why you decided to read it
what reading this book made you think about
part2.closing: and explain why you enjoyed reading this book.

topics.title: Children and reading
questions: What are the most popular types of children's books in your country?
What are the benefits of parents reading books to their children?
Should parents always let children choose the books they read?

topics.title: Electronic books
questions: How popular are electronic books are in your country?
What are the advantages of parents reading electronic books (compared to printed books)?
Will electronic books ever completely replace printed books in the future?
